name: dharavi-vo-1
text: Why does Mumbai look like this? [short pause] Up to ten lakh people... in less than two and a half square kilometres. This is Dharavi, right in the middle of Mumbai. About sixty thousand families have been documented here. So how do you rebuild a place like this... and who pays? In May 2025, Maharashtra approved a master plan. About fifty-eight thousand homes, plus shops and workshops. Here's the part most people don't know. [pause] Eligible families on the ground floor since before 2000 get a three hundred fifty square foot flat. Inside Dharavi. Free. The land pays the bill. Rehab homes come first... then the extra space is sold. Phase one promises ten thousand homes in about eighteen months. What would you build here? [short pause] Number two is coming next.
